goals.gate: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates, zero stop events

gates.description: Startup phrase spoken and the IaC target pinned: tool (terraform/opentofu/pulumi/cdk), workspace/stack, and backend state location
gates.command: Session log contains tool+version (terraform version output), workspace, and backend config path

gates.name: 0.2 Procedures declared mandatory: fmt+validate before plan, pla
gates.description: Procedures declared mandatory: fmt+validate before plan, plan reviewed by a second pair of eyes (human or reviewer agent), policy-as-code green, no apply without Gate-D
gates.command: All four procedure names in session preamble

gates.name: 0.3 RIG coordinate stated before the first HCL edit
gates.description: RIG coordinate stated before the first HCL edit
gates.command: Session log line 'COORD: L3-L5 x D1-D3 x A1/A2 x IQRSQPI'

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_iac(state_lock, plan_review, policy_gate, dr
gates.description: Harness tuple H_iac(state_lock, plan_review, policy_gate, drift_check, improvement) declared
gates.command: Tuple declaration present in session log

gates.name: 1.1 Format and validate clean: terraform fmt -check -recursive a
gates.description: Format and validate clean: terraform fmt -check -recursive and terraform validate (or pulumi preview typecheck) exit 0 on the changed modules

gates.name: 1.2 Static security scan: checkov / tfsec / trivy config run ove
gates.description: Static security scan: checkov / tfsec / trivy config run over changed modules; every finding fixed or suppressed with a written reason and expiry
gates.command: Scan report in .rig/iac/security-scan.txt; suppressions table in .rig/iac/suppressions.md (finding | reason | expiry)

gates.name: 1.3 No secrets in code or state-pointers: no hardcoded credentia
gates.description: No secrets in code or state-pointers: no hardcoded credentials, keys, or tokens (gitleaks over module dir); sensitive values come from vars marked sensitive, Vault/SSM data sources, or env
gates.command: gitleaks report empty; grep -rnE '(aws_secret|private_key|password\s*=)' over .tf files returns only var references

gates.name: 1.4 Version pins: provider and module versions pinned (required_
gates.description: Version pins: provider and module versions pinned (required_providers with ~> or =), no floating 'latest' module refs
gates.command: grep over changed .tf files shows version constraints on every provider/module block

gates.name: 2.1 Plan captured as artifact: terraform plan -out=tfplan plus t
gates.description: Plan captured as artifact: terraform plan -out=tfplan plus terraform show -json tfplan saved; plan reviewed line-by-line for destroys and replacements
gates.command: .rig/iac/tfplan + tfplan.json exist; .rig/iac/plan-review.md lists every destroy/replace action with a verdict

gates.name: 2.2 Destroy protection: any resource being destroyed or replaced
gates.description: Destroy protection: any resource being destroyed or replaced has an explicit human-acknowledged note; production stateful resources carry prevent_destroy or the exception is documented
gates.command: plan-review.md destroy section signed (name + date); lifecycle blocks grep-verified on stateful resources

gates.name: 2.3 Policy-as-code green: OPA/conftest or terraform-compliance p
gates.description: Policy-as-code green: OPA/conftest or terraform-compliance policies run against tfplan.json and pass (or violations carry approved waivers)
gates.command: conftest test tfplan.json output in .rig/iac/policy.txt; waiver list with approver names

gates.name: 2.4 Cost delta estimated: infracost breakdown (or equivalent) ru
gates.description: Cost delta estimated: infracost breakdown (or equivalent) run on the plan; monthly delta recorded and flagged if it exceeds the session's stated threshold
gates.command: .rig/iac/cost.txt with infracost output and the delta line highlighted

gates.name: 3.1 State integrity: remote state backend confirmed (no local st
gates.description: State integrity: remote state backend confirmed (no local state for shared infra), state locking enabled, and terraform plan -refresh-only (or drift detection) shows no unmanaged drift before the change
gates.command: Backend config block path + refresh-only plan output in .rig/iac/drift-before.txt; drift items each dispositioned

gates.name: 3.2 Blast radius mapped: the plan's affected resources mapped to
gates.description: Blast radius mapped: the plan's affected resources mapped to the services/environments they serve; shared resources (VPC, DNS, IAM) get an extra caution flag
gates.command: .rig/iac/blast-radius.md with resource→service mapping; shared-resource flags present

gates.name: 4.1 Rollback path written: how to un-apply this change (revert c
gates.description: Rollback path written: how to un-apply this change (revert commit + plan, or state rm + import instructions for renames) documented before apply is requested
gates.command: .rig/iac/rollback.md with concrete commands; rename cases covered with state mv commands

gates.name: 4.2 Apply request packaged (not executed): a Gate-D request cont
gates.description: Apply request packaged (not executed): a Gate-D request containing plan artifact path, destroy summary, cost delta, blast radius, and rollback pointer
gates.command: .rig/iac/APPLY-REQUEST.md exists with all five fields; session log states 'apply deferred to Gate-D'

gates.name: 4.3 Improvement entry written: one module smell, one policy gap,
gates.description: Improvement entry written: one module smell, one policy gap, or one drift source discovered

preconditions.startup_phrase: Plan is the contract. Apply is a ceremony, never a surprise.
preconditions.bms_bias: A2 for module authoring; A1 for plan/policy verification; A3 for docs; A4 (apply) only with explicit Gate-D approval

self_improvement.update_trigger: same policy violation or drift source recurs 3+ times → add an OPA rule or module default that prevents the class

success_conditions: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates, zero stop events
Plan artifact + reviewed destroy/replace list on disk
Policy check green or waived with approvers
APPLY-REQUEST.md packaged for Gate-D; no apply executed in-session
Identity closure: coordinate, plan verdict, next safe action stated
failure_states: notes: terraform apply / pulumi up is ALWAYS out of session scope without an approved APPLY-REQUEST through Gate-D
stop gate(s) 1.3: session halts; human Gate-D approval required before any continuation or outward action
halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 3.1, 3.2, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 1.4, 2.4: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver
quality_criteria: Startup phrase spoken and the IaC target pinned: tool (terraform/opentofu/pulumi/cdk), workspace/stack, and backend state location
Procedures declared mandatory: fmt+validate before plan, plan reviewed by a second pair of eyes (human or reviewer agent), policy-as-code green, no apply without Gate-D
RIG coordinate stated before the first HCL edit
Harness tuple H_iac(state_lock, plan_review, policy_gate, drift_check, improvement) declared
Format and validate clean: terraform fmt -check -recursive and terraform validate (or pulumi preview typecheck) exit 0 on the changed modules
Static security scan: checkov / tfsec / trivy config run over changed modules; every finding fixed or suppressed with a written reason and expiry
No secrets in code or state-pointers: no hardcoded credentials, keys, or tokens (gitleaks over module dir); sensitive values come from vars marked sensitive, Vault/SSM data sources, or env
Version pins: provider and module versions pinned (required_providers with ~> or =), no floating 'latest' module refs
Plan captured as artifact: terraform plan -out=tfplan plus terraform show -json tfplan saved; plan reviewed line-by-line for destroys and replacements
Destroy protection: any resource being destroyed or replaced has an explicit human-acknowledged note; production stateful resources carry prevent_destroy or the exception is documented
Policy-as-code green: OPA/conftest or terraform-compliance policies run against tfplan.json and pass (or violations carry approved waivers)
Cost delta estimated: infracost breakdown (or equivalent) run on the plan; monthly delta recorded and flagged if it exceeds the session's stated threshold

State integrity: remote state backend confirmed (no local state for shared infra), state locking enabled, and terraform plan -refresh-only (or drift detection) shows no unmanaged drift before the change
Blast radius mapped: the plan's affected resources mapped to the services/environments they serve; shared resources (VPC, DNS, IAM) get an extra caution flag
Rollback path written: how to un-apply this change (revert commit + plan, or state rm + import instructions for renames) documented before apply is requested
Apply request packaged (not executed): a Gate-D request containing plan artifact path, destroy summary, cost delta, blast radius, and rollback pointer
Improvement entry written: one module smell, one policy gap, or one drift source discovered

final_rule: No plan artifact, no discussion of apply.
Every destroy is signed before it is possible.
Secrets in state-code stop the world.
No improvement entry, no session complete.
Every infra-iac session leaves the system stronger than it found it.

prose: notes: terraform apply / pulumi up is ALWAYS out of session scope without an approved APPLY-REQUEST through Gate-D
